summary: Frontend-only testing of the regional (Telangana + AP) programmatic SEO expansion on the preview URL. Verified regional procedure/condition pages (Vijayawada, Warangal, Visakhapatnam), metro page regression (Hyderabad), WhatsApp CTA hrefs, related-link navigation, homepage + header nav, and sitemap. 100 regional slugs spot-checked over 20 cities x 5 page types: all HTTP 200, zero 404s, zero console/page errors. One real SEO defect found: /sitemap.xml served is a STALE STATIC file in public/ that shadows app/sitemap.js and contains only 192 URLs with NO programmatic/regional slugs.

integration_issues.issue: /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml is a stale static file (192 <loc> entries, no programmatic pages) and takes precedence over the dynamic app/sitemap.js route (whose built body is 388KB and DOES contain vijayawada/warangal/etc.). robots.txt points to this stale sitemap, so ~1,860 new regional/metro programmatic pages are not discoverable via sitemap. Fix: delete public/sitemap.xml (let app/sitemap.js serve it) or regenerate the static file from the full page list.

action_items: Remove or regenerate /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml so /sitemap.xml includes all regional programmatic slugs (verify grep vijayawada in the served sitemap > 0).
critical_code_review_comments: public/sitemap.xml silently shadowing app/sitemap.js is a duplicate source of truth for sitemap generation — keep only the dynamic generator to avoid regressions on future page additions.
programmaticSEOPages.js is a large single-module generator (~366 lines, content banks + builders); consider splitting taxonomy/content-banks/builders if it grows further.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all page-render/CTA/nav checks pass; sitemap coverage fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified passing: /best-knee-replacement-in-vijayawada (H1 'Best Knee Replacement Surgeon for Vijayawada Patients', hero wa.me/919959964567 + tel CTA, stats 4,000+/15+/8,000+/95%+, 'Travelling from Vijayawada?' section with data-testid='regional-whatsapp-btn' whose href prefills 'I am from Vijayawada...', 6 FAQs, 'Across Telangana & Andhra Pradesh' related links, related-link click navigates to /best-partial-knee-replacement-in-vijayawada OK); /cost-of-hip-replacement-in-warangal; /knee-arthritis-treatment-in-visakhapatnam; /best-knee-replacement-in-hyderabad (metro framing 'Outer Ring Road', no regional button); homepage + About nav. Use /app/tests/check_slugs.sh for bulk slug 404 sweeps (takes >2 min, run in background).
rca_of_the_issue: Next.js serves files in public/ before matching app routes, so the legacy hand-written public/sitemap.xml (192 URLs, generated before the programmatic expansion) overrides the dynamic app/sitemap.js output which correctly includes 53 vijayawada references. Reproduce: curl $BASE/sitemap.xml | grep -c vijayawada -> 0, while grep -c vijayawada .next/server/app/sitemap.xml.body -> 53.
